title: Too expensive
body: You click squares and colours appear, it keeps tracks of how many times you clicked the square in a row, 30€ per year with no possible major feature upgrades since 2.0 is out apparently. Some people enjoy overpaying, I don’t. I wouldn’t even pay 30€ for lifetime access. There’s real software that has one time cost lower than this “college project” for more features.
